why: The refusals of the door that exports one run's conversation (GET and POST /api/conversations/:run/export). tests/one-conversation-exports-with-the-parts-he-ticks.test.ts meets conversationExportHomePath through the door, case 7, conversationExportLookFirst, case 8, conversationExportKeyHash, case 9, and conversationExportRuntimeNotRead, case 13, each with a made-up home folder, transcript, agent and run of its own. No door here can meet any of them: this test's office has no made-up home folder, no conversation file, no agent with a handover or a personal space, and no run that names a runtime. The others need a run record with a field missing or a conversation file that is missing, unreadable or over the line, which the export test does not make.

Test: this release reads no conversation of the runtime a-made-up-tool.
Test: no conversation id was recorded for this run.
Test: this run's conversation id cannot be used as a file name.
Test: no working directory was recorded for this run.
Test: this run's conversation file is not there.
Test: this run's conversation could not be read.
Test: this run's conversation is over the 256 MB one export carries.
Test: handover.md still holds a home folder path.
Test: handover.md holds something shaped like a key.
Test: space/keys/held.bin holds a key hash this office issued.
Test: there are 2 things to look at before this conversation leaves.
